brief.claim: A drug changes the evoked response more in visual cortex than in auditory cortex: the drug-minus-placebo difference in response amplitude is larger in the visual region than in the auditory region across 16 participants, at the two-sided 0.05 level.

data_keys.meaning: evoked amplitude in visual region under placebo
evoked amplitude in visual region under drug
evoked amplitude in auditory region under placebo
evoked amplitude in auditory region under drug

brief.sizes: 16 participants, every participant measured in both regions and both conditions.
